claims: Samsung is discontinuing its proprietary Samsung Messages app in July 2026.
Samsung is transitioning entirely to Google Messages as the default texting application on all Galaxy devices.
Samsung has been moving toward Google Messages for years.
Many newer devices already use Google Messages as the default.
Samsung Messages app is not being preinstalled on new devices.
In July 2026, the Samsung Messages app will no longer be able to send or receive messages, except for emergencies, on many Galaxy phones.
Users on older operating systems (Android 11 or lower) are generally not affected
